name: materialcomposer-simple
description: Simple ladder for materialComposer (Compose finishes): opens the FinishPicker for a room, expands the 'Compose your own…' Disclosure inside the floor tab, applies a composed procedural finish via the real Apply button, and asserts the store records a compose:<pattern>:<hex> finish id. materialComposer is simple-tier (present in both Simple and Pro) — asserted ON in both modes.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-materialcomposer-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: materialComposer should be ON in Simple mode (it is simple-tier)

steps.name: finish-picker-visible
steps.failMessage: FinishPicker (.panel.inspector) did not appear after room selection

steps.name: composer-controls-visible
steps.failMessage: MaterialComposer's Apply button did not appear after expanding the Disclosure

steps.name: options-visible
steps.failMessage: The Select's option list (portalled Popover) did not open

steps.name: verify-composed-finish-stored
steps.failMessage: Expected finishes.floor['livingDining'] to be a compose:<pattern>:<hex> id after Apply

steps.name: verify-materialcomposer-on-in-pro
steps.failMessage: materialComposer should still be ON in Pro mode (simple-tier flags are shown in both modes)

steps.name: composer-still-present-in-pro
steps.failMessage: MaterialComposer's Apply button should still render in Pro mode
